messages:
sana (SRE): Heads up — we're seeing intermittent stalls on streaming token responses from hosted-prod in eu-west-1. Spike in user-visible latency and some gRPC stream cancellations around 22:10 UTC.
mike (infra): I saw alerts too. Any correlation to pod restarts or autoscaler activity?
sana (SRE): No restarts. CPU/GPU and pod counts steady. p95 token latency jumps then recovers. Looks network-y: packet retransmits + high packet reordering on some node pairs.
lee (runtime): Symptoms match packet reordering causing TCP segments to be processed out-of-order; gRPC deadlines/trailing windows mis-handle reordered segments and trigger stalls. Do we have tcpdump / tc stats?
olga (network): Pulled a tcpdump from host-3 -> host-7 path. Not huge loss but reordering/jitter. Snippet:

```
17:21:34.123456 IP host-3 > host-7: seq 1000 ack 0 len 1448
17:21:34.124100 IP host-3 > host-7: seq 2448 ack 0 len 1448
17:21:34.124400 IP host-3 > host-7: seq 1448 ack 0 len 1448  # arrived late
```

olga (network): SROCE counters show occasional PCIe queue interference; paths over the same ToR have less reordering. Cross-rack East-West more affected.
lee (runtime): Streaming tokens rely on steady low-jitter TCP with small writes. Reordering rips up Nagle/GSO assumptions and causes retransmits. Also seeing gRPC CANCELled with "DeadlineExceeded" in traces.
sana (SRE): Impact: user streams drop and client sees partial finalization. A/B traffic shows 0.7% request failure spike during window.
mike (infra): Quick mitigation options:
- steer latency-sensitive traffic to same rack (topology-aware pod affinity)
- disable GSO/TSO on affected NICs (reduces reordering but higher CPU)
- enable TCP reorder agnostic transport? (RDMA / RoCE has in-order guarantees if configured)
- bump gRPC timeouts/enable more aggressive write coalescing in runtime

lee (runtime): Practical short-term: pin streaming workers to same rack to avoid cross-rack path. Also push a runtime change to extend streaming RPC soft-deadline by 200ms for eu-west-1 only.
olga (network): I'll open a ticket with infra provider — likely a switch buffer scheduling bug causing microbursts and packet reordering when flows share egress lanes. Also checking MTU: some paths had 1500 vs 9000 mismatch; fragmentation increases reordering risk.
sana (SRE): We tested `tc qdisc netem` locally to simulate reorder, reproduces stall pattern. Repro command used:

```
# on host-7
sudo tc qdisc add dev eth0 root handle 1: netem delay 10ms 5ms distribution normal reorder 25% 50ms
```

mike (infra): Cost/ops note: disabling offloads on 2000 hosts will increase CPU by ~6-10% and push GPU scheduling. Need cost approval for a wider rollout.
lee (runtime): Experiment plan:
1) Canary pod affinity -> same ToR for streaming service (1 hr)  
2) Runtime soft-deadline + small backoff for token streaming (canary)  
3) If still bad, disable GSO/TSO on canary hosts and measure CPU/gpu interference

sana (SRE): Running step 1 now in eu-west-1 canary subset (hosts 1-16). Will watch p50/p95 tokens and gRPC cancels. Posting updates in 15m.
infra-bot: deploy: canary-affinity-streaming -> eu-west-1 (16 pods) started by sana at 22:34 UTC :rocket:
mike (infra): If canary helps, long-term fix is firmware/switch upgrade and proper RDMA fabric config (RoCEv2 with PFC or native in-order fabric). But that's multi-week and involves provider maintenance windows.
olga (network): Also adding MTU audit across clusters and creating a runbook for detecting reordering via tcp_info `tcp_retransmits` + `reordering` heuristics.
sana (SRE): Update: after affinity canary p95 token latency dropped from 420ms -> 110ms on canary. Non-canary still noisy. Looks like cross-rack path was the main culprit. Rolling to more racks cautiously.
lee (runtime): Good. Once we stabilize, we'll add an adaptive deadline heuristic: if we detect jitter/reorder on path, increase stream window and avoid hard deadline cancels while switching to fallback model variant.
sana (SRE): Filed follow-ups: #1 infra ticket to vendor (switch firmware + escalate), #2 MTU audit + fix, #3 shortlist for controlled RDMA testbed. Closing immediate incident but leaving monitoring alerts on stricter thresholds.
mike (infra): Thanks. Please attach traces + pcap to the infra ticket. Also include cost estimate for offload disable test.
olga (network): PCAPs and netstat outputs uploaded to infra ticket INF-4821.
sana (SRE): Closing thread — continuing rollouts. If you see regressions ping @channel. :thumbsup:
